Men and women with stubborn fat in the abdomen, waistline, flanks, or lower back who are looking for a more sculpted silhouette may be good candidates for Lipo 360. Ideal candidates are in good overall health and close to their target weight.
Most patients experience swelling, bruising, and soreness during the first 1–2 weeks after surgery. Compression garments are typically worn to support healing and help optimize contouring results.
Results from Lipo 360 can be long-lasting when combined with a stable weight and healthy lifestyle. Once fat cells are removed, they do not return.

faqs.q: Who is a candidate for Lipo 360?
faqs.a: Men and women with stubborn fat in the abdomen, waistline, flanks, or lower back who are looking for a more sculpted silhouette may be good candidates for Lipo 360. Ideal candidates are in good overall health and close to their target weight.

faqs.q: What is recovery like after Lipo 360?
faqs.a: Most patients experience swelling, bruising, and soreness during the first 1–2 weeks after surgery. Compression garments are typically worn to support healing and help optimize contouring results.

faqs.q: How long do Lipo 360 results last?
faqs.a: Results from Lipo 360 can be long-lasting when combined with a stable weight and healthy lifestyle. Once fat cells are removed, they do not return.
